mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT act02_journal_id AS journal_id , act02_company_id AS company_id , act02_date AS date , act02_journal_no AS journal_no , CAST(act02_journal_no AS varchar) AS journal_no_str , act02_corp_id AS corp_id , f_get_journal_corp_nm(act02_journal_id) AS corp_name , act02_note AS note , COALESCE(( SELECT sum(act03_dr_amt) FROM act03_journal_dtl WHERE act03_journal_id = act02_journal_id ), 0) AS journal_amt , f_emp_kor_nm(act02_person_id) AS person_name , f_get_relate_dcr_count(act02_journal_id) || ' 건' AS dcr_count_str , COALESCE(act02_fix_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS fix_yn , CASE WHEN coalesce(act02_fix_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '승인' ELSE '' END AS fix_yn_name , CASE WHEN coalesce(act02_close_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '마감' ELSE '' END AS close_name , act02_cur_cd AS cur_code FROM act02_journal WHERE act02_company_id = #{companyId} AND act02_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND act02_tr_id IS NULL AND act02_biz_id IS NULL AND act02_bmt_id IS NULL AND act02_pay_month_cd IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pay50_expense WHERE pay50_journal_id = act02_journal_id ) AND ( ( '1' = COALESCE(#{abroType}, '1') AND /* 1:국내 */ COALESCE(act02_cur_cd, 'KRW') = 'KRW' ) OR ( '2' = COALESCE(#{abroType}, '1') AND /* 2:국외 */ COALESCE(act02_cur_cd, 'KRW') != 'KRW' ) ) ) a WHERE UPPER(coalesce(note, '') || coalesce(corp_name, '')) LIKE upper(#{searchText}) ORDER BY date, journal_id

SELECT act02_journal_id AS journal_id , act02_company_id AS company_id , act02_date AS date , act02_journal_no AS journal_no , CAST(act02_journal_no AS varchar) AS journal_no_str , act02_corp_id AS corp_id , f_get_journal_corp_nm(act02_journal_id) AS corp_name , f_get_journal_note(act02_journal_id) AS note , COALESCE(( SELECT sum(act03_dr_amt) FROM act03_journal_dtl WHERE act03_journal_id = act02_journal_id ), 0) AS journal_amt , f_emp_kor_nm(act02_person_id) AS person_name , f_get_relate_dcr_count(act02_journal_id) || ' 건' AS dcr_count_str , COALESCE(act02_fix_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS fix_yn , CASE WHEN coalesce(act02_fix_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '승인' ELSE '' END AS fix_yn_name , CASE WHEN coalesce(act02_close_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '마감' ELSE '' END AS close_name , COALESCE(act02_cur_cd, 'KRW') AS cur_code FROM act02_journal WHERE act02_company_id = #{companyId} AND act02_journal_id = #{journalId}
